verdict.rationale: Orrick's free Tech Studio includes an "Incorporation Questionnaire (Germany)" form, and a community user reports the firm handled their Delaware C-corp incorporation. That shows formation support, but nothing in the pack shows published guidance comparing entity types or jurisdictions. Missing for 10: any published guidance or articles on choosing an entity type or jurisdiction; coverage of Delaware C-corp vs UK Ltd vs GmbH/UG vs Indian Pvt Ltd; market-based selection criteria; independent corroboration that such guidance exists.
